Resolve each conflict using whatever signal actually distinguishes the two updates. Do NOT use timestamps to decide, even if you can infer relative recency — two branches that were disconnected from each other have no shared clock, so 'later' does not mean 'more correct' here. If source, confidence, and ancestor context give no real basis to prefer one branch over the other (e.g. both are equally plausible, equally-sourced preference changes), explicitly flag it as unresolvable rather than guessing.
